title: Draft: Qt: More DisplayFilterEdit tweaks
description:
Use rounded corners on icon border

Fix vertical line position, but perhaps just don't draw it at all.

notes.body:
1. Removing the separator line does not look good. This is why I made commit fc99b22825bf94fc38ea2414dd80d476293b40aa.
2. The background color visible in the rounded corners does not look good. I get some flashbacks from when I improved this last year, so clearly this is not the correct solution.
